articleEn: Why You Can't Fully Enjoy Life — Growing Up Too Fast
articleCn: 為什麼你總是無法好好享受生活？

days.topic_en: Growing Up Too Fast — Guilt When Life Gets Easy
days.topic_cn: 太早長大 — 生活變輕鬆反而內疚

sentences.text: Some people had a childhood, others had responsibilities.

keywords.def: the period of life when you are a child
duties you are expected to take care of

sentences.text: They learned early how to handle problems, control their emotions, and keep going even when nobody was there to guide them.

keywords.def: deal with difficulties yourself
continue despite difficulty
to show someone the way or give direction

sentences.text: And because they became mature so young, people often assume they have everything figured out.

keywords.def: behaving like a sensible adult
understand life and know exactly what to do

sentences.text: But psychology suggests that growing up too fast can leave behind struggles that aren't always obvious.

keywords.def: to cause something to remain afterwards
difficulties that take effort to deal with
easy to see or notice

sentences.text: Psychology connects this to hyper-responsibility, where a person becomes overly focused on preventing problems and taking care of what needs to be done.

keywords.def: an excessive sense of duty for everything around you
paying too much attention to

sentences.text: Sometimes, you feel guilty for not being needed.

keywords.def: feeling you have done something wrong
to be necessary or useful to others

achieving or producing a lot; not wasting time

speaking.en: Did you grow up faster than the people around you, or did you have a carefree childhood?
speaking.cn: 你比身邊的人更早長大，還是擁有無憂無慮的童年？

speaking.en: Do you feel guilty when you finally have free time to relax? Why?
speaking.cn: 當你終於有空閒時間放鬆時，會感到內疚嗎？為什麼？

speaking.en: When nothing needs fixing, can your mind simply rest? What happens instead?
speaking.cn: 當沒有事情需要處理時，你的腦袋能真正休息嗎？還是會發生什麼？

speaking.en: Where does the pressure to always be productive come from, in your life?
speaking.cn: 在你的生活中，「一定要有生產力」的壓力是從哪裡來的？

speaking.en: Is being needed by others important to how you value yourself?
speaking.cn: 「被別人需要」對你的自我價值感重要嗎？

days.topic_en: What Do I Want? — Losing Touch with Your Own Wishes
days.topic_cn: 我想要什麼？— 與自己的渴望失聯

sentences.text: You don't know what you actually want.

keywords.def: really; in fact

sentences.text: When you grow up too fast, many of your decisions may have been based on what was necessary rather than what you wanted.

keywords.def: built or decided according to something
needed; required by the situation
instead of

sentences.text: You learn to ask, "What needs to be done?"

keywords.def: is required or must be completed

sentences.text: Not necessarily, "What do I want?"

keywords.def: not always true in every case

sentences.text: Over time, this can make your own preferences surprisingly difficult to recognize.

keywords.def: gradually, as time passes
the things you like or want more than others
to identify or notice something

sentences.text: You may be good at making practical decisions for everyone else, yet struggle when someone asks you what you want for your life.

keywords.def: sensible and realistic, focused on what works
to find something very difficult

vocab.def: a thing you like or want more than others
sensible and focused on what works in real life

speaking.en: Are you better at knowing what needs to be done than knowing what you want?
speaking.cn: 比起知道自己想要什麼，你是不是更擅長知道「該做什麼」？

speaking.en: When was the last time you made a decision purely because YOU wanted it?
speaking.cn: 你上一次純粹因為「自己想要」而做決定是什麼時候？

speaking.en: If money and duty didn't matter, what would you want for your life?
speaking.cn: 如果金錢和責任都不是問題，你想要什麼樣的人生？

speaking.en: Why do you think some people lose touch with their own preferences?
speaking.cn: 你認為為什麼有些人會與自己的喜好失去連結？

speaking.en: How could someone practice asking "What do I want?" more often?
speaking.cn: 一個人要怎麼練習更常問自己「我想要什麼」？

days.topic_en: Older Inside — When Growth Doesn't Move at One Pace
days.topic_cn: 內心比實際年齡老 — 不同步的成長

sentences.text: You feel older than your age.

keywords.def: more mature than your actual years

sentences.text: There may be moments when you're around people your age and realize you don't relate to the way they think anymore.

keywords.def: others born around the same time as you
to understand and feel connected to

sentences.text: It's not necessarily because you think you're better than them.

keywords.def: superior to

sentences.text: You simply had experiences that forced you to become serious earlier.

keywords.def: made you do something without choice
thoughtful and responsible rather than playful

sentences.text: Psychology sometimes refers to this as asynchronous development, when different parts of someone's emotional and social development don't progress at the same pace.

keywords.def: calls this by the name of
growth where different parts mature at different speeds
at an equal speed

sentences.text: You may look your age, but certain experiences made you feel much older inside.

keywords.def: appear as old as you really are
in your inner feelings and thoughts

speaking.en: Do you ever feel older inside than your actual age? In what situations?
speaking.cn: 你有沒有覺得內心比實際年齡老？在什麼情況下？

speaking.en: Do you still relate to the way people your age think? Why or why not?
speaking.cn: 你還能理解同齡人思考的方式嗎？為什麼？

speaking.en: What experiences forced you to become serious earlier than others?
speaking.cn: 哪些經歷讓你比別人更早變得成熟認真？

speaking.en: Is feeling older than your age a strength, a burden, or both? Explain.
speaking.cn: 內心比實際年齡老，是優勢、負擔，還是兩者都有？說說看。

speaking.en: How do you stay connected with friends whose life pace is different from yours?
speaking.cn: 當朋友的人生步調跟你不同，你如何維持彼此的連結？

days.topic_en: "I'm Fine" — Hiding Problems Until the Limit
days.topic_cn: 「我很好」— 把問題藏到快撐不住

sentences.text: You hide your problems until they're almost unmanageable.

keywords.def: to keep something secret from others
too difficult to deal with or control

sentences.text: You became used to handling things yourself.

keywords.def: grew accustomed to; made it a habit

sentences.text: So, even when you're struggling, asking for help can feel strangely uncomfortable.

keywords.def: requesting support from others
in an unexpected or odd way

sentences.text: You might tell people, "I'm fine." because explaining everything feels harder than simply dealing with it yourself.

keywords.def: making something clear by describing it
taking action to handle a problem

sentences.text: This can create a pattern where you appear calm and capable while carrying much more than people realize.

keywords.def: a repeated way of behaving
able to do things well
bearing a weight or burden, here emotional

sentences.text: And sometimes, the people around you don't even know you needed help until you've already reached your limit.

keywords.def: arrived at the point where you cannot take any more

vocab.def: too big or difficult to deal with or control
to be familiar with something because you do it often
having the ability or skill to do something well
to get to the point where you cannot cope any more
to take action in order to solve a problem

speaking.en: Is it hard for you to ask for help, even when you're struggling? Why?
speaking.cn: 即使很辛苦，你還是很難開口求助嗎？為什麼？

speaking.en: When you tell people "I'm fine", how often is it actually true?
speaking.cn: 當你跟別人說「我很好」時，有多常是真的？

speaking.en: Have you ever carried a problem alone until it was almost unmanageable? What happened?
speaking.cn: 你曾獨自扛著問題直到快撐不住嗎？後來怎麼了？

speaking.en: How can you tell when someone who "seems fine" actually needs help?
speaking.cn: 你怎麼看出一個「看起來很好」的人其實需要幫助？

speaking.en: What would make asking for help feel easier for you?
speaking.cn: 什麼樣的改變會讓你更容易開口求助？

days.topic_en: Switching Off — From Surviving to Living
days.topic_cn: 學會關機 — 從生存模式走向真正生活

sentences.text: When you've spent years thinking about consequences, responsibilities, and what could go wrong, your mind can become heavily focused on the future.

keywords.def: the results of actions, often negative
possible problems or failures
concentrating very strongly on

sentences.text: Even during good moments, part of your mind may still be thinking about the next problem.

keywords.def: enjoyable or happy times

sentences.text: You may simply have never learned how to completely switch off.

keywords.def: to stop thinking about work or problems and relax

sentences.text: Sometimes, the person who seems incredibly mature still has a part of them that wonders what life would have been like if they didn't have to become strong so early.

keywords.def: extremely; very
thinks curiously about

keywords.kw: what life would have been like
keywords.def: how life might have turned out differently

sentences.text: So, if you sometimes feel exhausted from always being the strong one, it doesn't mean you're ungrateful for how far you've come.

keywords.def: extremely tired
the person others depend on
not appreciating what you have

sentences.text: But adulthood can also be the place where you finally learn that you don't have to spend the rest of your life surviving.

keywords.def: the period of life as a grown-up
just staying alive and coping, not truly enjoying life

vocab.def: to stop thinking about work or worries and truly relax
focused mainly on the future rather than the present
to want something very strongly
not showing thanks or appreciation for what you have
extremely tired, with no energy left

speaking.en: Can you fully enjoy good moments, or is part of your mind already on the next problem?
speaking.cn: 你能完全享受美好時刻嗎？還是腦中已經在想下一個問題？

speaking.en: What helps you completely switch off after a busy week?
speaking.cn: 忙碌一週後，什麼能幫你完全「關機」放鬆？

speaking.en: Is there a simple childhood pleasure you still crave today? What is it?
speaking.cn: 有沒有一種簡單的童年快樂是你現在仍然渴望的？是什麼？

speaking.en: What is the difference between surviving and truly living, in your view?
speaking.cn: 在你看來，「生存」和「真正生活」的差別是什麼？

speaking.en: After studying this article all week, what is your biggest takeaway about growing up too fast — and what would you say to the part of you that had to become an adult too early?
speaking.cn: 學完這篇文章一整週，你對「太早長大」最大的收穫是什麼？你想對那個太早成為大人的自己說什麼？
